Episode 257. The Demon Army' Attack (2)
White Fleet 3rd Flagship, the Ridel.

The Ridel had not yet crossed the dimensional gate. Originally, it should have already crossed over and taken its position at the front, but the members of the Demon Army on board the Ridel were staring with their mouths agape as they watched the vanguard collapse to the Plutonian Cannon.
“...W-what in the world is this.”
“Don't tell me, has M-Malugia appeared or something?”

In all their time conquering all dimensions, they had always held an overwhelming advantage in fleet battles. In the first place, many other dimensions didn't even possess a 'fleet' at all, aside from the Zipple.
That was why the power of the Golden Fleet and the flying fortress Laprarosa was coming as an even greater shock to the Demon Army.

Rondo Zipple, who was in charge as the supreme commander of this invasion, barely held onto his fading consciousness and looked at the crystal ball. He could see nothing but the ash and dust that was once the White Fleet.
“Damage report. Report the damage status! What has become of the vanguard's Genesis Knights!”
“Lord Kal of the 35th dimension is deceased, and Lord Huegeron and Lord Chukon are also presumed to have sustained fatal injuries! We must rescue them at once...!”
“No. We will abandon those two. Not only that, but we must abandon all the remaining fleets of the vanguard as well.”
“Lord Rondo, but.”
“Don't you understand! Their bombardment won't end with just one shot. If we carelessly try to rescue them, we'll get caught in it too.”
A silence fell within the ship.
The other fleets that were scheduled for the charge were also waiting for Rondo's command. Whether to proceed and enter the battlefield as planned, or to be on standby for now.

-Furthermore, such will sometimes leads to miracles. That is why the powerhouses of the 677th dimension have so far failed to kill the anomaly named Jin Runcandel. The Vamel Alliance is a powerful enemy, the likes of which no other dimension has ever faced.
-My thinking was short-sighted.

-You all probably believe that since we rule all dimensions except the 677th, and since we possess a completed Origin Stone, we can surely eliminate them. Wrong. Their swords are already at our throats.
Rondo momentarily recalled the conversation he had with Kelliark at the Demon Army headquarters in the 1st Passage.
'Lord Kelliark was right... the 677th dimension is different. Furthermore, that flying fortress was an object that didn't even exist when we had that conversation.'
Honestly, before the invasion, Rondo and the other members of the Demon Army had expected an overwhelming victory.
Even if the Vamel Alliance had five Genesis Knights, they had prepared more Genesis Knights, and they believed their fleet strength was on a level that couldn't even be compared.
A naval cannon that could kill a Genesis Knight in a single blow was an object that not even the Demon Army possessed.

'We should have invested more in strengthening our fleet's combat power. To think that we do not possess an achievement that was accomplished with the power of just one dimension. We were too reliant on the home base's Origin Stone...'
The Origin Stone.
During their dimensional conquest wars, the Demon Army had never once brought a 'completed Origin Stone' directly to the battlefield.
It could cause bigger problems due to interdimensional interference, and it was a safer and more efficient means in many ways to acquire and strengthen the local Origin Stone.

In other words, since the Demon Army had always successfully suppressed the local Genesis Knights through their existing fleet and such Origin Stones, there had been no need to strengthen their naval cannons to this extent.

'Was it Dr. Qwaul? That person also showed particular prominence in the 677th dimension. Jin Runcandel, that one person is changing everything. He is making this place special. No, he has already made it so. We must not let him get his hands on that power.'
And that Jin Runcandel was here.
Beyond the dimensional gate, it was as if he could see the figure of Jin standing tall on the land of the Black Sea (in reality, Jin was crouched down from the shock of the Plutonian Cannon).
“...We must kill him.”
“Lord Rondo?”

“Jin Runcandel, we must kill him in this battle. There is no need to bother with capturing him alive. We will surely kill him. By any means necessary. Request support from the headquarters of all dimensions at once. Here in the Black Sea, I will surely settle the score with him.”

At those words, the executives standing nearby cautiously watched Rondo. Their faces said, is it alright to move that many troops without Kelliac's review. Furthermore, since the main force of the Demon Army had recently suffered a grave blow from Malugia, the executives couldn't help but have a generally passive attitude.

“In any case, if the traces of Malugia that were left in this dimension due to the last battle with Lord Kelliark disappear, a large-scale dimensional travel like this will require time. Furthermore, Lord Kelliark has already expressed his intention to commence an all-out war at the last meeting, so I will take all responsibility.”
“Proceeding with the support request from each dimension.”
“Lord Rondo, what will you do about the fleets on standby for the charge? They are waiting for your command.”
“Charge as planned.”
{Lord Rondo!?}

{W-wait! Lord Rondo, please reconsider. Malugia's energy is gathering again towards the enemy's flying fortress. Didn't you just say you were abandoning the Genesis Knights? If we go out like this, we too will meet the same end as the vanguard...}
The captains who had confirmed Rondo's order hastily raised their voices through the ship's communicators. As they said, Lafrarosa had finished reloading the second Plutonian Cannon.
“I did not give the order to charge to rescue the Genesis Knights. History will remember your deaths.”
{...Pardon?}
“It cannot be helped. We need arrow fodder. We must push in our forces endlessly. So that an opening is created when the enemy naval cannon is reloading. The main force will enter at that time.”
It was bewildering and unfair.

However, since there was no one here who had more of Kelliark's trust than Rondo, they did not dare to refuse his order. If they refused the order, it was obvious that they would be executed even more cruelly at the hands of Kelliac or Rondo later.
{...But Lord Rondo, excluding the 3rd fleet, all the fleets that were scheduled to enter have at least one or more Genesis Knights on board. Do you intend to use even them as arrow fodder?}

“In the first bombardment, one Genesis Knight died, and two survived. If more Genesis Knights are committed, their combined power of existence will be stronger, so the survival rate will rise. If about three of them can just withstand the bombardment and enter the battlefield, that will be the moment for the main force.”
Settle the score by any means necessary.
Before that resolve, even a Genesis Knight could become just a special kind of arrow fodder. It was a barbaric tactic that only the Demon Army could employ.
{Understood...}
“I shall wait for the day we finally conquer time and meet you all again. I wish you the fortunes of war.”
Wooooooong...!
The power sources of the fleets on standby began to vibrate.
{For the Zipple!}
[For the Zippleeee!]
With those crazed voices as their last, beyond the dimensional gate where the Milky Way flowed, the fleet of the Demon Army began to advance towards their deaths.

The second Plutonian Cannon finished off the two Genesis Knights who had been critically wounded, and it dealt a similar blow to the White Fleet that had newly emerged from the dimensional gate as it did the first time.
“This is crazy, this time too, it finished off not just the fleet but another Genesis Knight. The other remaining one is half a corpse too.”
If the third Plutonian Cannon were to fire, that Genesis Knight who had become half-dead would also meet his death.

So to speak, the Vamel Alliance had already killed five of the Demon Army' Genesis Knights. As it was the same number as the Genesis Knights the coalition possessed, it could be called a truly enormous achievement. Especially since there were no casualties at all on their side.
“But are these bastards out of their minds? Genesis Knights are continuously dying absurdly to the bombardment, what the hell are they trying to do?”
Murakan said, roughly running his hand through his hair.

Although the battle situation so far was clearly an overwhelming victory for the Vamel Alliance, he was feeling a strange sense of unease. Because the enemies were not changing their strategy even after losing five Genesis Knights.

The Demon Army was sending out a new fleet even before the aftereffects of the second bombardment had cleared. Similarly, this time too, the fleet included a Genesis Knight. Murakan's sense of unease was bound to slowly turn into a sense of crisis.
“...They call themselves the hegemon of all dimensions. Does that mean they can even use a Genesis Knight as arrow fodder.”
Jin said, gritting his teeth.
“Father, the situation is not good.”

“It looks that way to me too. The enemy commander is accurately aware that our flying fortress's naval cannon is not infinite. That must be why he is continuously committing Genesis Knights, so that they can immediately establish a position on the ground as soon as the cannon's power decreases or its reloading time slows down.”
“Yes, he is a cruel and sharp bastard. No matter how many Genesis Knights they have, to expend them like this must surely be a blow even to the Demon Army. He has made a decision. To finish us here.”
They had to hope that the reinforcements would be cut off before they used up all the shots of the Plutonian Cannon.
The hope that Jin had had when the first bombardment ended was already wrong. Because the Demon Army was, on the contrary, committing its forces even more actively.
“Brother Baba, how many more times can we use the Plutonian Cannon?”
{At most 5 times, Brother Battle God. But the power will not be the same for all 5 shots. Brother Boras says that an overload is already in progress on the hull.}
“Understood.”
Five times.
If the enemies could continue to deploy Genesis Knights as they were now even after that, the Vamel Alliance's chances of victory would become infinitely low.
So Jin had to choose. Whether to abandon the arrangement and retreat for now, or to defend this position somehow.
The deliberation was not long.

“In any case, if we retreat now, the next battle will unfold in a situation that is far more advantageous to the enemy than to us. The reason those bastards are pushing themselves now is probably because of the arrangement. Above all, even if we retreat, we will still be in the mortal world. There is no way those bastards won't pursue us.”
Chiron and the Genesis Knights nodded.
“For now, we will call for reinforcements as well. I will need your help, Father. Even if Lord Focal and Lady Silkia open the path.”
“Understood.”

The Genesis Knights and the coalition members hardened their fighting spirit as they looked at the white fleets that were pouring out endlessly. Even if the Plutonian Cannon was depleted, the strongest warriors and fleets of the mortal world were still here.
“...It will be a difficult fight. However, we will be victorious.”
